title: Starter kits in the site editor's Theme tab: apply a kit as one undo step

source.ref: Phase 2 of the theme and kit library (LIVE-1341). Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/KnVnxpTGVzMJ2pUxTVevfi

detail: The Theme tab lists the starter kits. Choosing one offers three modes (add its pages, replace my pages with a second confirm, look only). Applying loads the kit on demand, builds the draft with the block registry's default props, commits it as one undoable editor step and saves the site theme the way the theme list does when the kit wears another theme. Nothing reaches the live site until publish, apart from the theme, which the Theme tab already applies at once. Not in this row: the full-website entitlement check on add and replace, a side-by-side preview, the sample-copy highlight and publish warning.

verify.evidence: Theme tab lists the kits; apply is one undo step (commit with a label); lib/sites/kits tests (8) check every kit block is registered and the applied site validates with registry defaults. Full type check and changed-file lint clean locally.
